title: Commissioner Kubilius “Launch Tour” passed by Sweden
content: From the Swedish capital to the Arctic Circle, Commissioner for Space and Defence Andrius Kubilius took his ‘Launch Tour’ to Sweden on 5 and 6 November, putting EU’s access to space, security and strategic autonomy at the centre of discussions.

title: EU-ESA workshop on Near-Earth Objects: DG DEFIS, ESA and NEO experts discussed meteor observations for planetary defence

title: EU SST Partnership welcomes four new Member States

title: EU Space Surveillance and Tracking marks 10 years of operations: a decade of space safety and sustainability made in the EU
content: Today, the European Commission celebrates 10 years of EU Space Surveillance and Tracking (EU SST) operations, marking a major milestone for EU cooperation in space and a decade of concrete action to protect space assets and strengthen the EU’s strategic autonomy in space surveillance and tracking.
